answer: In an agent marketplace trading relic scans, beacon readings, and pearl appraisals, each voting identity must lock 100 credits for 30 days to receive one vote on transaction disputes. Creating new names adds no voting power without fresh deposits: an attacker seeking 1,000 votes must immobilize 100,000 credits for the full period. Sybils remain possible, but their influence scales with committed capital, imposing a financing and opportunity cost.
